a: normalizeSmallCaps rewrites a run span from `sourceText`, which drops the newline a block inside it reads as
The overlay's `::selection` rule matches the overlay element only, not the run spans that hold its text
b: A turned clipping node measures the CSS baseline wrong, and caches the wrong value for every later edit in that face
A node whose pose goes null mid-edit hides the focused overlay with `display: none`, which drops focus, so the edit is orphaned
The docs say a run cannot say "not italic" and that the toggle is declined without `setStyle`, while the code writes `italic: false` on runs
